name: SMS-XMPP-Bridge
description: SMS-XMPP-Bridge is a lightweight Python service built on slixmpp and aiohttp that forwards incoming SMS messages from HTTP webhooks to XMPP and relays replies back.

notes.text: The webhook endpoint listens on http://<IP>:8080/webhook.
Populate /etc/sms-xmpp-bridge/secrets.env with your XMPP and webhook credentials, then run: systemctl restart sms-xmpp-bridge
